import os
os.makedirs('programs',exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    ones=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==1]
    top=min((r,c) for r,c in ones if r==min(x[0] for x in ones))[1]
    bottom=max((r,c) for r,c in ones if r==max(x[0] for x in ones))[1]
    left=min(c for r,c in ones if c==0)
    right=max(c for r,c in ones if c==C-1)
    # markers identify a horizontal and vertical axis
    vr=next(r for r,c in ones if c==0)
    vc=next(c for r,c in ones if r==0)
    hit={(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if r==vr or c==vc}
    seen=set()
    for r in range(R):
      for c in range(C):
        if g[r][c]==2 and (r,c) not in seen:
          stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
          while stack:
            y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
            for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
              q=(y+dy,x+dx)
              if 0<=q[0]<R and 0<=q[1]<C and g[q[0]][q[1]]==2 and q not in seen:
                seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
          if any(p in hit for p in comp):
            for y,x in comp: g[y][x]=1
    for c in range(C): g[vr][c]=1
    for r in range(R): g[r][vc]=1
    return g
'''
open('programs/task-f91ce6bb.py','w').write(code)
